title: '20260510'
version: 0.50.1
date: 2026-05-10
description: A new desktop onboarding flow, email-and-password sign-in, automatic worktrees for local projects, and team visibility for projects that don't live on GitHub.
---
### New

- Added a desktop onboarding flow that makes it easier to land your first conversation.
- You can now sign in with email and password.
- Local projects can provision a worktree on demand, and it is reclaimed automatically when the session is archived.
- Settings → Projects now lets you make a local project visible to your team, so non-GitHub projects can be collaborated on alongside the rest.
